name: AWS SAM CLI (Local Serverless Toolkit)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source CLI to build, package, locally test and debug AWS Lambda/serverless applications using Docker; no software license or CLI usage fee.
watch_out: The free CLI is not free AWS hosting: sam deploy, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation-related resources, networking and logs may incur AWS charges and may require a billing account; local Docker and compute are your responsibility.
